buildings:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production-ready transparent PNG sprite atlas for an isometric town-building videogame.
Primary request: Create exactly 12 separate, beautifully crafted game-building sprites in a strict four-column by three-row regular grid on an ACTUAL fully transparent background with alpha (not a white or checkerboard background). Target canvas 2048 x 1536, making each cell 512 x 512. Each subject is centered horizontally in its own cell, including its base and cast shadow, with at least 15 percent transparent padding on all four sides. No sprite, shadow, smoke, foliage, or props crosses any cell boundary. All 12 cells are identical dimensions. No visible grid or frames.
Camera: perfectly consistent 2:1 isometric orthographic ground plane, 45-degree azimuth, elevated three-quarter viewing angle, same camera for all sprites.
Style: warm exquisite painterly 3D casual mobile/PC game art, soft handmade textures, cream plaster walls, terracotta-red shingle roofs, moss-green plants, warm natural sunlight from upper left, soft ambient occlusion, readable silhouettes, rich careful small details.
Exact order left to right top to bottom:
Row 1: cozy red-roof cottage; windmill with exactly four wooden sails; bakery with brick oven chimney; grand town hall with a clock tower.
Row 2: lumber camp with neatly stacked logs; stone quarry with pale stone and wooden crane; small fishing hut with wooden dock; colorful village market with green-and-cream striped awnings.
Row 3: stone water well with timber roof; large red-roof barn warehouse; fire watchtower; flower garden with a bench and tree.
Every asset includes only a very compact attached patch of earth/grass/planks needed for its footprint, with soft alpha shadow. In the fishing hut cell, the dock sits over a tiny attached water patch entirely inside that cell. No extensive ground tiles or large platforms. Scale tower assets down enough to keep a full transparent margin around the tips. NO text, labels, numbers, UI, watermark, characters, checkerboard, background, borders or visible grid. Output one single transparent atlas image.
world:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: full-bleed landscape playable background map for a warm isometric town-building videogame.
Primary request: Paint an exquisite high-quality storybook 3D isometric natural clearing, landscape 16:10 composition, at 2048x1280 if possible. It is a continuous grounded landscape that fully covers every pixel of the canvas, never a floating island.
Scene: a huge open softly textured pale moss-green grass clearing occupies about 75 percent of the image, especially the center and center-right, deliberately empty and buildable. Subtle grass strokes, a few tiny flowers, softly varied moss patches. A dense border of rounded deciduous trees mixed with a few conifers occupies the far upper-left and far upper-right perimeter, leaving the playable center wide open. At the distant top edge, a few hazy pale green hills and soft atmospheric depth. A narrow curving turquoise river follows the lower edge from lower-left to lower-right, with a graceful slight curve, pale riverbank stones, a few reeds, sunlight in the shallow water. The river stays in the bottom 15 percent of the image and MUST NOT divide or occupy the central buildable clearing.
Camera: elevated orthographic isometric, compatible with 2:1 isometric terrain and 45-degree building azimuth, coherent scale across the map. Ground extends to all edges.
Style: warm painterly 3D casual mobile and PC game environment, polished handcrafted textures, soft ambient occlusion, mossy sage greens, warm cream highlights, inviting amber daylight from upper left, painterly foliage shapes, rich carefully designed detail only around the edges, center low-contrast and sparse.
Constraints: ABSOLUTELY NO buildings, huts, roads, paths, fences, objects, ruins, boats, people, animals, UI, text, logos, watermarks, visible grid, checkerboards, isolated island, cutout shape, white margin or border. Do not paint an existing town; this is an empty playable clearing waiting for construction.
